previous.review_surface: Original returned pixels actually inspected through white and black alpha composites; raw file retained unchanged.
previous.observation: Actually viewed current raw/white/black, original source and original three-view identity. The side correction now has plausible FAR anatomical-LEFT occlusion: most red root hidden by bob, gray/mint lock behind visible neck/collar and lower turns behind white shoulder frill; no exposed near-ear bead pair and no mirrored body. However current broad mint/gray coil surfaces still show directional light-to-dark volume shading, unlike unlit bob and required flat palette. Agree with Sol actual round44 preliminary: retain this corrected far-side geometry and original right-facing closed-eye/bent rear arm, but whole redraw must flatten only hair materials throughout. Do not reopen root to reveal both beads or swing it to near ear. Not a usable final; fresh whole redraw and reviews required.
